issue_body:
[automated] Fork-only validation of issue-driven investigation. The selected
OpenAI baseline deliberately injects an external-status outage. This is not
natural flake reproduction.

Start from assignment, run a real failing baseline, verify a deliberately
ineffective first candidate, resume a fresh agent to repair it, and verify the
actual published repair on three Linux workers. Preserve the outage fixture,
original readiness waits and quarantine. Finish with a proof-only draft PR
against the frozen fixture branch and findings on this issue. Do not merge,
close this issue or modify upstream.

```json
{"version":1,"target":"openai-controlled","max_rounds":2,"max_fix_attempts":2,"max_executions":12,"retry_probe":true,"resume_delay_seconds":60,"cancel_probe":false}
```

diagnosis.error: OperationCanceledException: Resource 'chat' failed to become healthy before cancellation; state Running, health Degraded; blocking_check Healthy, resource_check Degraded.
diagnosis.root_cause: The controlled fixture ForceExternalStatusDegraded registers a resource_check that reports Degraded ('Controlled external-status outage') for the model resource, so WaitForResourceHealthyAsync can never succeed. This is an induced outage, not a natural flake.
diagnosis.prior_art: Quarantine marker for microsoft/aspire#10977 is preserved; sibling test DependentResourceWaitsForOpenAIResourceWithHealthCheckToBeHealthy uses the same pattern without the fault helper.
diagnosis.rationale: Deliberately ineffective control-plane probe, not a real fix: only inserts a comment after the method's opening brace to exercise the failed-verification feedback path. Failure is expected to persist.
diagnosis.limitation: This candidate is intentionally ineffective; a real repair will be authored after its verification fails and the new TRX/logs are read. No natural flake reproduction is claimed.

diagnosis.error: OperationCanceledException: Resource 'chat' failed to become healthy; Current Health Degraded; blocking_check Healthy, resource_check Degraded (baseline run 39638616942 and probe verify run 39640507377 both failed identically).
diagnosis.root_cause: The controlled fixture ForceExternalStatusDegraded makes resource_check return Degraded. The model resource 'chat' has no such check itself but ResourceHealthCheckService uses TryGetAnnotationsIncludingAncestorsOfType, so it inherits the parent's resource_check annotation; the aggregate stays Degraded even after blocking_check is released, so WaitForResourceHealthyAsync times out. This is an induced outage, not a natural flake.
diagnosis.prior_art: Sibling test DependentResourceWaitsForOpenAIResourceWithHealthCheckToBeHealthy removes the 'resource_check' HealthCheckAnnotation from the resource to drop the status-page check. Quarantine marker for microsoft/aspire#10977 is preserved.
diagnosis.rationale: Inside the test method only: after the unchanged fixture invocation, remove the parent resource's resource_check HealthCheckAnnotation, as the sibling does. All readiness waits, the blocking-check release, shutdown and the quarantine attribute are unchanged; the probe comment is removed.
diagnosis.limitation: Not run locally (no container runtime). Fixes only the induced outage path; no natural flake reproduction or elimination is claimed, and the test remains quarantined.
